description:
The workspace's own brand's share of ALL brand mentions in AI answers, and which brands hold the rest -- every brand the models named, each marked as a tracked competitor or not.

Use this tool when the user asks who the AI talks about -- phrases like 'share of voice', 'who gets mentioned most', 'which brands does AI recommend in our space', or 'who else shows up'.
Do NOT use to rank against the competitors the user tracks (use get_competitor_comparison, which measures the share of answers that mention each tracked brand).

Returns: own share in percent, own rank, and the top brands with their shares.

Example: 'Which brands does AI mention most when people ask about our category?'

competitor_limit.description: How many other brands to list. Default 5, max 20.
competitor_limit.title: Competitor Limit

days.description: How many days back to look, counted back from end_date (default today). Default 30, max 90. Ignored when start_date is given. Prompts are re-run on a schedule, so a window shorter than a week can be empty.
days.title: Days

end_date.description: Optional end of the window, as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default today. Cannot be in the future.
end_date.title: End Date

start_date.description: Optional explicit start of the window, as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). A full ISO datetime is accepted and its date is used. Overrides days.
start_date.title: Start Date

workspace_id.description: The workspace's numeric id, as returned by list_workspaces.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

name: get_share_of_voice
title: Share of voice
